title: The contracts bundle merges mechanically: versions and digests are derived, not cut by hand
description: Every fold of main into a long-lived epic conflicts in contracts/bundle.json, CHANGELOG.md and cloudflare/contracts.pin.json because each side cuts versions by hand and both used the same numbers for different bytes (hn6 fold 2026-10-06 had to cut 2.1.0 above both). Make the bundle's version/digest ledger derivable (e.g. computed from the contract files at build/check time, or a merge driver that re-cuts) so two sides' contract changes merge without a person.
acceptance_criteria: Two branches that each change a different contract file merge with no conflict in the bundle/pin; contracts check passes; tests.
